doors.label: west_to_0x81

Direct walk from north/bridge south/west pits (sub 20, respawn north door). Isolated pin CastleZeldaB1East is already at east_b1 (recoveryPath). Reverse: CastleB1FarWest RIGHT. LandingXy unchanged.

notes: B1 east/bridge chamber; many work-queue states share this room base id.
Pit splits a north floor (0x72 door) from a south walkway (0x81 door). Walk around the east wall; do not cut south/west from bridge.
